description: Dress a model image with upper and/or lower garment assets, supporting optional masks and original garment references.

downImageUrl.description: Optional processed lower garment mask or crop URL.

downOriginUrl.description: Public URL of the original lower garment image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 4096 pixels in both width and height.

modelImageUrl.description: Public URL of the model image.

modelMaskImageUrl.description: Optional mask URL for the model body area.

outputNum.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.

upperImageUrl.description: Optional processed upper garment mask or crop URL.

upperOriginUrl.description: Public URL of the original upper garment image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 4096 pixels in both width and height.
